newsitem.title: GREECE: NATIONAL BANK BRANCH IN GJIROKASTER, ALBANIA ROBBED.
newsitem.headline: NATIONAL BANK BRANCH IN GJIROKASTER, ALBANIA ROBBED.

text.p: The branch of state National Bank of Greece in Gjirokaster, Albania was robbed late Monday night by 40 armed men, the state Athens News Agency (ANA) said.
"The gang immobilised the guards who were equipped with armoured vehicles, drilled a hole through the double wall of the vault and got away in a stolen police car," said ANA.
"Local residents called for reinforcements, yet none appeared although the entire operation lasted around two hours."
Children were playing with stray coins dropped from the robbers this morning, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
